details.name: Good Trip
details.title: Good Trip
details.description: Shan, an art assistant, juggles responsibilities on the film set and at the hospital, where she cares for her father, Kuen. During her time at the hospital, Shan is tasked by the crew to collect a big bowl from the prop-studio. At her father's request, they discreetly leave the hospital together, embarking on an unexpected journey from the studio to Macau, and subsequently to Okinawa, allowing Kueng to address his unfulfilled wishes. Following his peaceful passing, Shan inherits not only memories but also a lasting sense of courage, optimism, and imaginative spirit that sustains her throughout life.

details.name: Bitter Christmas
details.title: Bitter Christmas
details.description: Pedro AlmodÃ³var returns with a masterstroke! In Competition at the Cannes Film Festival, Bitter Christmas delivered a Spanish opening weekend box office that surpassed those of The Room Next Door and Parallel Mothers. Even the deepest wells of inspiration run dry. Refusing to become a has-been, a writer-director turns the lives of those around him into material for his scripts, blending reality and fiction. Meanwhile, an advertising director grieving her motherâs death tries to numb her pain through work, only to be struck down by severe, panic-induced headaches. Forced to step back, she travels to a remote island with her friend, seeking respite in a relationship charged with intimate friction. Two intersecting storylines mirror each other: those seeking relief remain consumed by tension, while those with ambition are drained of energy. Through AlmodÃ³varâs singular aesthetic, characters elegantly trap themselves within the beautiful cages of human emotion.

details.name: PRIMETIME
details.title: PRIMETIME
details.description:
Based on real events, the film follows news anchor Chris Hansen (Pattinson) and his team as they pioneer a radical new format: posing as underage teens in online chat rooms, they lure suspected child predators to a suburban home wired with hidden cameras. When the unsuspecting targets walk into the trap, Hansen bursts in with a camera crew and a police escort to confront them on the spot â all for live television.
The formula is explosive. Ratings soar. But the deeper Chris and his crew fall into the pursuit of viewers, fame, and "justice," the harder it becomes to tell where journalism ends and vigilantism begins â until the sting operations themselves spiral into a vortex they can no longer control.

details.name: Mastermind
details.title: Mastermind
details.description:
A suspect, unsuccessfully pursued by an unknown killer, mysteriously vanished from the detention cell in H City. Baffling by the case, Agent MO received a bewildering message from his friend YANG, the fugitive was found dead in a locked records vault of the Investigation Bureau headquarter, just 10 kilometers away. How did he escape from the detention cell and slip into the headquarters' records vault, moving from one 'sealed room' to another?


The murder bullet was later confirmed to be MOâs so-called lucky bullet, rattling the City Government Intelligence Bureau. The suspectâs death was bizarre, and Intelligence Bureau Commissioner BI was drawn into the vortex of the unsolved case. MO himself became the prime suspect, now hunted by both the underworld and the authorities. A mind-bending, tangled plot ensues. MO, YANG, and BI are manipulated by fate, forced to confront the a sensational and fiendishly difficult case!

details.name: V
details.title: V
details.description: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once "paved with gold," had fallen into a state of broken order and rampant crime. Man Zi-Keung (Zhu Yilong), a worker, is determined to rewrite his fate. After meeting flight attendant Lok Ka-Yuen (Michelle Wai), the two join forces to commit a heist, seizing a huge sum of money. This success drives Man Zi-Keung to ever greater extremes, pushing him and wealthy businessman Chan Fai-Yin (Leung Ka Fai ) deeper into a vortex of escalating confrontation. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang (Tan Jianci) and Hong Kong police officer Kwan So-San (Selena Lee) persist in investigating Man Zi-Keung. With the two police forces joining hands, the clash between good and evil is on the verge of eruption.

details.title: Trial of Hein (GFF)
details.description:
After fourteen years away, Hein returns to his remote North Sea island home, only to discover that the close knit community no longer recognises him. Even his childhood friend keeps his distance, and convinced he is an impostor, the villagers convene a court to determine his true identity. As his memories contradict every witness's account, suspicion curdles into open hostility, forcing Hein to confront what he has long refused to see. The debut feature of director Kai StÃ¤nicke, whose screenplay draws on his own coming out experience, probes how memory and identity are shaped and distorted.

 

2026    Teddy Jury Award, Berlinale

details.title: Prosecution (GFF)
details.description:
Young German-Korean prosecutor Seyo Kim is determined to bring far-right extremists to justice in Germany. When she survives a racist attack on her own life, she defies her superiors and takes the perpetrators to court herself, uncovering a right-wing network with ties deep into the institutions meant to stop it. Director Faraz Shariat's second feature is grounded in years of meticulous research into Germany's legal system and its handling of far-right violence, a subject that feels urgent at the moment.

details.name: Swan Lake (Paris Opera Ballet 2026 - 2027)
details.title: Swan Lake (Paris Opera Ballet 2026 - 2027)
details.description:
Broadway Cinemas is proud to exclusively present the Paris Opera Ballet's spectacular 2026-2027 season! Kicking this season off are two world-renowned ballet classics coming straight to the big screen: Romeo and Juliet and Swan Lake.

 

Prince Siegfried is urged by his parents to choose a bride, but by the shores of a lake he meets a mysterious swan maiden, Odette, enchanted by the sorcerer Rothbart. Only a sincere vow can save her. Captivated, he swears eternal love, until he meets Odile, the black swan...

 

A magical ballet set to Tchaikovsky's sparkling music, Swan Lake was first created in 1877 for the Bolshoi Theatre in Moscow, later restaged by Marius Petipa and Lev Ivanov. Nearly a century later, Rudolf Nureyev brought his own interpretation to the Paris Opera in 1984.

A native of this hedonistic underworld, Manon is caught between twin desires when she falls in love with the student Des Grieux. Steadfast and devoted, he offers the possibility of an honourable life. Yet, the riches promised by the world of Parisian society remain tempting...


Manonâs inner turmoil and struggle for survival lie at the devastating heart of Kenneth MacMillanâs 1974 adaptation of AbbÃ© PrÃ©vostâs novel. In this signature work of The Royal Ballet, MacMillanâs nuanced understanding of human psychology makes for an unflinching look into the moral degradation of Manonâs Paris, while all its decadence and decay are brought to life through Jules Massenetâs score and Nicholas Georgiadisâs designs.

details.title: Made in Hong Kong (bc30)
details.description: The first film in Fruit Chan's "Handover Trilogy", this raw, low-budget film tells a story about forgotten youth. With no hope for the future, four teenagers struggle between broken homes and street violence: Moon becomes a street hoodlum; Susan takes her own life after heartbreak; Ping is terminally ill and abandoned by her father; and Sylvester, who has an intellectual disability, is used to smuggle drugs. As tragedy strikes, what remains is a desperate cry against the world that abandoned them.

details.description: In near-future Tokyo, a prank on the school principal leads to the installation of an oppressive surveillance system. While the incident awakens high schooler Kou's political consciousness, his best friend Yuta remains oblivious, creating a rift that threatens their bond. Following Ryuichi Sakamoto: Opus, Neo Sora delivers a poignant feature debut exploring whether adolescent bonds can survive a volatile political landscape. While met with a modest reception in its native Japan, the film resonated deeply in Hong Kong, its first overseas theatrical stop, paving the way for the widespread international attention that followed.

details.title: Hidden Heroes (bc30 x APAAA)
details.description: Officer Yohji Ho meets a female android who comes from the future, in a drug raid. The android's mission is to ensure the death of Yohji, the elder brother of the future "Father of electronic Chips", so as to help the future scientist to become what he will be. At the meantime, Yohji is suspected as the murderer of a police officer. Scared and confused, Yohji flees and goes to Mei Ling, who looks identical to the android, for a fraud passport. Knowing Mei Ling is his brother's future wife, Yohji decides to kill her to save his own life. Being pursued by the police and the android, Yohji runs away with Mei Ling and starts their adventure.

details.name: Fatherland (bc30)
details.title: Fatherland (bc30)
details.description:
In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick, which takes them across a Germany in ruins. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also a deep fracture within his own family. With Fatherland, Pawlikowski explores the themes of identity, family, love and guilt amid the turmoil and confusion of post-war Europe in his elliptical, distilled style.

 

Best Director Award, Cannes Film Festival

Peter Wrightâs production of this festive family favourite sparkles to the wondrous swell of Tchaikovskyâs orchestral score, alongside the glow and grandeur of Julia Trevelyan Omanâs period designs.

details.name: Il Mare (bc30)
details.title: Il Mare (bc30)
details.description: 1999, a young woman leaves her quaint seaside house and returns to the city, leaving in the mailbox a card for the next owner, with instructions to forward any mail of hers to the new address. 1997, a jaded young architect moves into the same house and finds the letter. Following the box office success of Christmas in August and Shiri, Il Mare further cemented the growing influence of Korean cinema.

In James Gray's deeply felt and intense drama, two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be "too good to be true." Competition, Cannes Film Festival

details.title: All of a Sudden (bc30)
details.description:
Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy named "humanitude", which is rooted in active listening and respecting residents' dignity, despite strong resistance and disagreement from some of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path and perspective on the world. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

 

Best Actress Award, Cannes Film Festival

details.name: Cube (bc30)
details.title: Cube (bc30)
details.description: Six different people, each from a different walk of life, awaken inside a giant cube with thousands of rooms. The identical rooms hold the threat of hideously inventive and painful death. Each gifted with a special skill, they must work together to escape an endless maze of deadly traps. Finding the real exit, however, may not offer the freedom one seeks. A micro-budget pioneer of the escape-room genre that grew into a cult sensation, the film was released at bc in 2002 to introduce local filmgoers to this overlooked gem.

2023     Compass-Perspektive Award, Berlinale

details.title: Wild Horse Nine (bc30)
details.description:
Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Among the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone's trip to this remote paradise sideways. The latest work from Oscar-winning director Martin McDonagh is a poignant story of friendship and the devastating gap between the ideal and reality, accompanied by his trademark incisive dialogue and dark humour.

 

Best Actor Award, Venice International Film Festival

In rural France, Christophe tries to live up to his rigid, distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning, on the tractor, at school, at dinner. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, hediscovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

details.description: The true story of Elle France editor Jean-Dominique Bauby, who, in 1995 at the age of 43, suffered a devastating stroke. The damage to his brain stem results in locked-in syndrome, with which he is almost completely paralysed, except his left eye. Using that eye to blink out his memoir, Bauby eloquently describes the aspects of his interior world, from the psychological torment of being trapped inside his body to his imagined stories from lands he'd only visited in his mind.

details.name: The Water Will Carry Us (bc30)
details.title: The Water Will Carry Us (bc30)
details.description: Ten years ago, Wind's son vanished at sea while saving others. Clinging to the last traces of their bond, the aging boatman returned to live by the shore where they once trained for dragon boat races. A decade later, a surfer goes missing at sea, and rumors of a haunting spread along the shoreline. Seeing the family grieving by the water, Wind's own grief is stirred anew. Outside the dragon boat clubhouse, he lights an eternal lantern to guide the restless spirit home. The sea binds more than just the dead. Liz, the survivor saved by his son that day, prepares to emigrate to Australia, torn by guilt over leaving Wind behind. Meanwhile, her helper Zen forms an unspoken bond with Wind, uncertain whether to return across the ocean or remain on this shore. Carrying a past they cannot forget, each must now choose how to face the future.

details.title: Breaking the Waves (bc30)
details.description: In a small and religious coastal town, a simple, devoutly religious Scottish woman, Bess McNeill, finds a partner in an oil rig worker from Norway, Jan Nyman. However, the relationship grows strained when Nyman breaks his neck in a horrific work accident on the rig and becomes paralysed. Unable to perform sexually and suffering mentally from the accident as well, Jan convinces Bess to have sex with other men, which she comes to believe is God's work. bc went on to screen many of Lars von Trier's subsequent works, establishing him as one of the most unforgettable directors among cinephiles.

details.name: Coward (bc30)
details.title: Coward (bc30)
details.description:
On the Western Front of World War I, young soldier Pierre is eager to prove himself, but repeatedly retrieving the bodies of fallen comrades slowly shatters his courage. When an army show is organized to boost morale, Pierre is assigned to help build the set. On stage, Francis performs as a woman, his captivating charm stirring the young soldier's heart. While war rages outside, an untimely romance quietly takes root between them. Following Close, director Lukas Dhont captures forbidden love blooming against the brutality of war, led by two emerging actors who shared the Best Actor award at Cannes.

 

Best Actor Award, Cannes Film Festival

details.name: The Monk and the Gun (bc30)
details.title: The Monk and the Gun (bc30)
details.description: Kingdom of Bhutan, 2006. Modernization has finally arrived. Having been the last country in the world to connect to the internet and television, it now faces the biggest change of all: democracy. To teach the people how to vote, authorities organise a mock election, but the locals remain unconvinced. Travelling to rural Bhutan where religion matters far more than politics, an election supervisor discovers that a monk is planning a mysterious ceremony for election day. As the first Bhutanese film released in Hong Kong, it inspired bc to launch a popular social media vote on its wall colour, widening the film's reach.

details.description:
Academy Award-winning director Daniel Roherâs first narrative feature, Leo Woodall stars as a gifted young piano tuner, Niki heightened sense of hearing draws the attention of criminals, who see his talents as useful for opening safes as well as for tuning Steinways. With his once-promising musical career over, he works across New York with his mentor Harry (Academy Award-winner Dustin Hoffman), encountering a range of characters, including composition student Ruthie (Havana Rose Liu), with whom he forges an unexpected connection. Nikiâs safecracking work threatens his budding romance with Ruthie and pulls him into increasingly dangerous territory. TUNER also features performances from Tony Award-winner Tovah Feldshuh, Lior Raz, and Jean Reno.

When conflict is bound to erupt, between justice, love and life, which one is the most fragile?

details.description:
Bryan Cranston (Breaking Bad) and Marianne Jean-Baptiste (Hard Truths) feature in a five-star, triumphantly acclaimed new production of Arthur Millerâs classic play, from visionary director Ivo Van Hove (A View from the Bridge).


One family, the heart of the American dream. When wartime delivers profits for Joe, it comes at a price when his partner is charged with criminal manufacturing deals, and his eldest son goes missing in action. Will peacetime bring peace of mind, or will he be confronted by the consequence of his actions?


Filmed live from the West End, Paapa Essiedu (I May Destroy You), Tom Glynn-Carney (House of the Dragon), and Hayley Squires (I, Daniel Blake) also feature in this disturbingly prescient play.

details.title: Suzhou River (bc30)
details.description: Set along the bustle of Shanghai's Suzhou River, Lou Ye's neo-noir thriller recalls the dark romance and fascinating mystery of Vertigo. The girlfriend of the film's unseen narrator, coy club performer Meimei attracts the attention of ex-con Mardar, who once loved and betrayed a girl named Moudan. Now out of jail, he searches restlessly for Moudan, and encounters her doppelganger in Meimei. An edgy, elusive mix of gritty realism and urban romanticism, Lou's breakout feature launched him to international renown. bc also welcomed a young Zhou Xun in person for the film that would define her career.

details.name: Nagi Notes (bc30)
details.title: Nagi Notes (bc30)
details.description:
Bucolic Nagi is home to scenic landscapes, a unique art museum and a Self-Defense Force base. One day, Yuri travels to Nagi to model for her friend Yoriko, a wood carving artist. As wood shavings fall to the ground, the two gradually open up about past trauma. Meanwhile, two teenage boys grapple with anxiety and restlessness of growth, ultimately taking a bold step forward. Their actions might seem rash and reckless, but who doesn't yearn for that fearless impulse of youth? As the boys bravely embrace the future, the two women also gradually find their way forward.

 

Competition, Cannes Film Festival

details.title: Fjord (bc30)
details.description:
The Gheorghius, a devout Romanian Norwegian couple, resettle in a village set in a distant fjord where they become close to their neighbours, the Halbergs. Their children bond despite their different education. When adolescent Elia Gheorghiu shows up at school with some bruises on her body, the community asks itself if the traditional education that the Gheorghiu children get from their parents might have anything to do with it. This gripping, morally complex drama earned director Cristian Mungiu his second Palme d'Or.

 

Palme d'Or, Cannes Film Festival

It has since become a favourite among a new generation of cinephiles.

details.description: When Ali loses his sister Zahra's school shoes, this young pair dream up a plan to stay out of trouble: they'll share his shoes and keep it a secret! A box-office phenomenon in its day and a huge hit at bc, the film drew widespread attention to Iranian cinema.

details.description: Set in the Stockholm suburb of Blackeberg in 1981, Oskar, a bullied 12-year-old, strikes up a friendship with his new neighbour, the mysterious and moody Eli. She is full of contradictions; her wise look, her strange smell, the fact that she is wearing such thin clothing, her neglected and skinny, yet so beautiful, appearance. Initially reserved, a sweet romance blossoms between them. But a dark, macabre secret revealing Eli's connection to a string of bloody local murders threatens everything. Along with Black Ice, it sparked a new wave of interest in Nordic crime movies at the time, including films such as The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo and Headhunters.

When a mysterious incident in the fabled Macedonian mountains blows out of proportion, it threatens to start a civil war, and brings together a silent young monk, a London picture editor and a disillusioned war photographer in a tragic tale of fated lovers. Before the Rain explores the uncompromising nature of war as it ravages the lives of the unsuspecting, and forces the innocent to take sides...

details.name: La Luz (SFF2026)
details.title: La Luz (SFF2026)
details.description: Manuel is a provincial priest preparing to hang up his robes when his dark past comes to light, forcing him to face his actions. Seeking absolution, he approaches the youth he once harmed, inadvertently reopening old wounds. Directed by Fernando Franco from the abuser's perspective, takes an unflinching look at sin and its hidden consequences. It challenges religious institutions and asks a haunting question: can a sinner's guilt ever truly bring comfort to those they have broken?

details.name: The Image Book (bc30)
details.title: The Image Book (bc30)
details.description: As Godard approaches 90, he offers us another meditative reflection on the technologies and implications of cinema, in counterpoint to the atrocities of the Holocaust, the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and struggles across the Middle East. In five chapters, which Godard likens to the five fingers of the hand, he recycles images, sounds, and ideas from previous works, but also explores new territory. The Image Book is Godard's self-penned eulogy that shows him pushing the manipulation of image and sound to a new level as he pours out his pained analysis of who and what we are now.

She has a small apartment at Alexanderplatz, a masterâs degree in history, and a freelance contract. But underneath the appearance of her modern city life lurks an old myth: if the man Undine loves betrays her, she has to kill him and return to the water she once came from. So when her lover Johannes (Jacob Matschenz) leaves her for another woman, Undine thinks she has no choice â until in the moment of betrayal, she meets Christoph (Franz Rogowski), an industrial diver, and unexpectedly falls for him. This is a new, happy and innocent love filled with curiosity and trust. But when Christoph starts to feel that Undine is running away from something, she has to face her curse once and for all. She doesnât want to lose this love.

details.title: Amour (bc30)
details.description: Georges and Anne are in their eighties. They are cultivated, retired music teachers who have spent their lives devoted to their careers and to each other. Savouring their golden years in a comfortable apartment, their serene life is disrupted when Anne experiences a stroke that leaves her partially paralysed. As devoted as Georges is, the infirmities of aging shake his devotion. As he grapples with the formidable task of becoming Anne's full-time caretaker, the couple's bond of love is severely tested. Years after bc's 2008 retrospective "A Master of Provocation", Haneke entered a new chapter, facing mortality with rare tenderness.

details.title: Shall We Dance (bc30)
details.description: Suo Masayuki's global breakout hit made Koji Yakusho a household name, sweeping numerous accolades. Revealing a gentler side to its star, this delightful classic follows a bored salaryman who takes up ballroom dancing on a whim, escaping his ennui alongside eccentric classmates. Yakusho's adorably awkward performance epitomised a generation of silent men who could all use a little dancing in their lives. As the opening film of bc, it surpassed HK$2 million at the box office during an exclusive run, establishing a house record that has stood ever since.

details.description: A botched takeaway order sparks an unlikely battle of wills in We Are Born Good, the assured debut of Hong Kong filmmaker Yeung Leung Chuen. Aspiring actress Zoey is already at breaking point, weighed down by debt, disappointment and a city that seems determined to test her patience. When a neighbourhood restaurant refuses to remake her incorrect order at closing time, a petty grievance quickly escalates. As their confrontation spirals into chaos, hostility slowly gives way to an unexpected connection. Inspired by viral footage of trivia disputes erupting into violence, the film asks what drives ordinary people to the brinkâand whether kindness can still prevail.

details.title: Afterpiece (bc30)
details.description: Owen, once a celebrated stage director, has spent more than a decade lost in creative paralysis. In an attempt to revive his reputation, he sets out to produce a new play, casting a completely unknown female lead, to whom he is increasingly drawn. However, the sudden appearance of his former movie-star lover sets off a chain of events that blurs the boundary between performance and reality. The debut directorial feature by Keane Wong presents a compelling play within a play, inviting the audience to ponder the humanity in struggle infused with profound emotional depth and conflict.

details.description:
On July 27, 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the NÃ©pstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury. 


Now, this original concert film has been beautifully rescanned and remastered in 4K alongside a dynamic new audio mix, featuring many of Queen's favorite tracksâ"Bohemian Rhapsody,â "Crazy Little Thing Called Love," "I Want To Break Freeâ and "We Are The Champions." With three years to go before the fall of the Berlin Wall, this was the first Western rock concert performed in a stadium behind the then Iron Curtain. It was of such significance to the Hungarian authorities and film industry that a group of the countryâs top film cameramen and technicians were brought together to film it for posterity.

 

Donât miss Queen Budapest on IMAX screen and exclusive at Broadway Cinemas only !

details.name: Gendernauts: A Journey Through Shifting Identities (KINO)
details.title: Gendernauts: A Journey Through Shifting Identities (KINO)
details.description:
San Francisco, at the turn of the millennium. Monika Treut turns her camera on a community of artists, scholars, and performers who live beyond the boundaries of conventional gender, blending technology, biochemistry, and sheer boldness to reshape their identities on their own terms.

 

Asked whether they are male or female, the gendernauts simply answer: yes.

 

Made at a time when transgender lives were rarely portrayed with dignity or nuance, Gendernauts remains a landmark of queer cinema, celebrating gender not as a fixed destination but as an open, joyful frontier.

details.title: Magical Secret Tour
details.description: Wakako is a housewife living a quiet life with her husband Takashi and their two children. When Takashi collapses from a subarachnoid hemorrhage, she learns he has lost his job and fallen into gambling debt. With no financial support, Wakako accepts a suspicious job offer and travels to Singapore with her children. There, she is recruited into a gold smuggling operation. Though frightened, Wakako goes through with the job alongside two other women driven by hardship: Kiyoe, a postdoctoral researcher obsessed with K-pop, and Mayu, a pregnant single mother working at a hostess club. Exploiting lax security checks on women with children or injuries, the trio successfully carries out the smuggling. Not long after their first job, the trio returns to Singapore to smuggle gold on their own for more money.

details.name: Keep Real
details.title: Keep Real
details.description:
Can we live on our own terms, free from the world's judgment?


Wang Changhai (Bai Jingting), a man of extraordinary ability, returns to his hometown to take up a position at the grassroots level. Blunt and uncompromising from the start, he defies the advice of his seasoned colleague Lao Xia (Wei Xiang), disregards the delicate web of personal connections, and confronts corruption and injustice without flinching. Yet every step forward seems to land him in deeper trouble.


As he slowly comes to grasp the unwritten rules that govern the society around him, he begins to file down his rough edges, learning to maneuver and compromise within the complex game of social etiquette. When idealism clashes with reality, and raw talent meets the weight of convention, what path will this once-unyielding man ultimately choose in this wry, down-to-earth comedy of manners?

details.title: Where To? (KINO)
details.description:
In the endless nights of Berlin, a 55 year old Palestinian Uber driver named Hassan shuttles revellers from one party to the next, estranged from his daughter and adrift without purpose. One night a young Israeli tourist exploring his sexuality far from home stumbles into his cab, and months later reappears, now living in Berlin and nursing a broken heart. Across two years of recurring rides, Hassan begins to recognise echoes of his own buried pain, and is finally pushed to confront the past that led him to leave his homeland thirty years ago. Perspectives programme at the 2026 Berlinale.

 

Supported by: Consulate General of Israel in Hong Kong and Macau

details.description:
Confident fourth-grader Fujino draws a four-panel manga for her school's class newspaper and earns the admiration of her classmates.
One day, however, she comes across a manga by Kyomoto, a classmate who has stopped attending school, published in that same newspaper â and is completely floored by her overwhelming talent. From then on, driven by a single-minded desire to improve, Fujino keeps drawing, but she cannot close the gap between them, and eventually gives up drawing altogether.
On graduation day, Fujino visits Kyomoto's house to deliver her diploma, and discovers that Kyomoto has been a devoted fan of her manga all along.
Bound together by their shared passion for manga, the two begin drawing manga together. As Fujino and Kyomoto spend irreplaceable days together, an unexpected event happens that will change their lives forever.

He serves up classic Chinese dishes: the DragonâRaisingâItsâHead feast, candied sweet potatoes and Kung Pao chicken. He partners with restaurant manager Ma Junsheng (Jiang Qiming): Xu Fu handles the cooking, while Ma Junsheng takes care of guests. Together, they turn the littleâknown Dragon Restaurant into a thriving spot.


War soon breaks out, and local conditions quickly turn dangerous. Different armed groups clash across the region. What will happen to Xu Fu? Can Dragon Restaurant survive amid the chaos of war?

details.title: Days Of Being Wild (4K Restored Version)
details.description: Hong Kong, 1960. A sweltering hot summer. York (Leslie Cheung), an amoral disillusioned and cruel young man is kept in luxury by his foster mother, a retired courtesan, who gives him everything but the one thing he needs to know - the identity of his natural mother. A self-obsessed man, desperately seeking his true identity, York plays carelessly with his lovers, a lonely submissive bargirl (Maggie Cheung) and a beautiful club dancer (Carina Lau) and his friends, before leaving them all for the Philippines in search of the truth that has been denied, and may ultimately destroy him.

Winner of the Palme dâOr and nominated for four Academy Awards, Scorseseâs raw portrait of urban alienation remains an essential diagnosis of a society defined by loneliness. details.name: Farewell to my Concubine (4K Restored Version)
details.title: Farewell to my Concubine (4K Restored Version)
details.description:
Douzi, a boy with feminine features, is abandoned by his prostitute mother to an all-boys Peking opera troupe supervised by Master Guan. Douzi befriends fellow trouper Shitou.

A few years later in 1938, a teenage Douzi is trained to play dan (female roles), while Shitou learns jing (painted face male roles). When practicing the play "Dreaming of the World Outside the Nunnery", Douzi intentionally mistakes the line "I am by nature a girl, not a boy" with "I am by nature a boy, not a girl," subjecting himself to severe physical punishments. Douzi along with another student, Laizi, attempt to run away, but Douzi decides to pursue acting seriously after witnessing an opera performance. Upon returning, they find the whole troupe being punished for their desertion, and Douzi is beaten. As a result, Laizi hangs himself...

details.title: HEAT (4K Restoration)
details.description:
Heat is a gripping crime thriller directed by Michael Mann, starring Academy AwardÂ® winners Al Pacino and Robert De Niro. Neil McCauley (Robert De Niro), a highly skilled and disciplined professional thief who leads a crew specializing in high-stakes heists across Los Angeles. On the other side is Vincent Hanna (Al Pacino), a relentless LAPD detective whose dedication to his job matches McCauleyâs commitment to his criminal craft.

As McCauley and his crew plan their biggest score yet, Hanna and his team close in, leading to an intense game of cat and mouse. Both men struggle to balance their personal lives with their professional obsessions, blurring the lines between hunter and hunted. The film builds to a climactic confrontation, exploring themes of loyalty, sacrifice, and the thin line separating lawmen from lawbreakers.

Renowned for its realistic action sequences, complex characters, and the legendary face-off between Pacino and De Niro, Heat is considered a landmark in the crime genre.

details.description:
A stunning 4K restoration of this masterpiece will return to big screen celebrating its 30th anniversary. 

Jules Winnfield and Vincent Vega are two hitmen out to retrieve a suitcase stolen from their employer, mob boss Marsellus Wallace. Wallace has also asked Vincent to take his wife Mia out a few days later when Wallace himself will be out of town. Butch Coolidge is an aging boxer who is paid by Wallace to lose his next fight. Honey Bunny and Pumpkin are a couple of young lovers and small time thieves who decide they need a change of venue. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exhilarating motion picture adventure that both thrills and amuses.
